newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent retraces gains on bout of profit taking.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent retraces gains on bout of profit taking.

text.p: IPE Brent retraced gains on Monday, pulled off earlier highs in a bout of profit-taking, brokers said.
"(NYMEX crude) came in very strong with heating oil and the cold weather in the (U.S.) Midwest but then it came under pressure and we saw some good selling coming in on Brent," said one dealer.
Feb Brent was trading two cents up at $24.36 a barrel, having just dipped to a session low at $24.25.
The contract had climbed to an intra-day high of $24.60 shortly after the NYMEX open.
Feb gas oil fell to $224 a tonne, $2.25 down on the day.
"Gas oil was easy to push lower with a gap to fill to $224," a broker said.
Brokers said that heating oil's strong early performance had helped support gas oil despite milder temperatures in Europe.
"The cold weather is expected in the States now, but heating oil couldn't hold its opening break," said a dealer.
Independent forecaster Weather Services Corp expected below-normal temperatures this week in the U.S. Northeast and Midwest.
